title.en: A deep-fry trace inside the band, one that runs hot, and the limit that cuts heat at 200 degC

goal.en: Deep frying is oil at 160 to 190 degC with a one-rung ladder. The envelope check reads the trace; the SafetyLimits pack says what the device does when oil passes 200 degC: cut heat.

note.en: Oil warms to 170, 178 and 175 degC with the koshari target of 175 plus or minus 10.
The oil climbs to 205 degC: it left the envelope.
The first limit in the default pack applies to frying and deep frying: above 200 degC the device cuts heat on its own.
Without an oil thermometer there is no rung, even with a person watching.

cli: printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 150}, {"t": 30, "tempC": 170}, {"t": 60, "tempC": 178}, {"t": 90, "tempC": 175}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.deep_fry trace.json --target 175 --tolerance 10
printf '[{"t": 0, "tempC": 150}, {"t": 30, "tempC": 170}, {"t": 60, "tempC": 185}, {"t": 90, "tempC": 205}]' > trace.json && cookwala envelope cw.op.deep_fry trace.json --target 175 --tolerance 10

outcome.en: You know the three facts a fryer must implement: the band, the single rung, and the local limit above it. Next: scenario 034 plans koshari on the fryer robot with estimates forbidden.
